exposure: duration of severe special education coding
involvement with other services (mental health, health care, educational achievement)
cohort: The study included 31,346 children aged 3 to 8 years, categorized by the presence and level of special education codes (none, mild, or severe).
finding: Among children with severe special education codes, many years of severe coding had the strongest association with family disability service use (prevalence ratio 5.50; 95% confidence interval 4.10-7.37).
